title: MaxBLD report rendered tree (the node contract)
$comment: THE one home of the report node contract (Spec 126 11a.7 structured tree; 126:552 R-27 one home; Spec 135 FE-29). Every golden `rendered_tree` validates against it; src/tests/surfaces/report-honest.logic.test.ts reads it and holds no copy; the renderer (MF-14) throws on a tree that fails it and the validator (MF-15) runs the same file. `status` = the 11a.3 closed forms plus `none` (no reading on this node; FE-28; Spec 122 1.2 per-field idiom inherited by 126:295); `confidence` = the 11a.4 set plus `none`; `provenance` = the 11a.4 sources plus `none`. `none` on a reading node and the one-message-node rule of a lifecycle tree are enforced by the lock, not by this shape. `slots` (MF-20; Spec 126 11a.10, FE-22, FE-23): the sponsored slots, ROOT-ONLY and never a node, so a slot cannot sit inside a card (R-34 as a schema fact); each carries its non-empty `disclosure` (R-17); `scenario` is set exactly for the per-scenario slot `scenario_card` (checked by the lock and the renderer, not by this shape: an if/then fails Ajv strict). The image node (MF-38; Spec 126 11a.7 and Spec 135 FE-29 dated notes 2026-11-11; O-1 b): ONE closed node kind chosen by `kind: image` (an if/then whose `if` declares `kind`, which Ajv strict accepts), carrying no value, status, confidence, provenance or disclosures (an image is not a reading); one item per scenario key (a key of report-v2-seed/row-presentation.json), at most one image node per tree and none in a lifecycle tree (checked by the lock and the renderer); `alt` is non-blank and has no {placeholder}; the tree never carries a URL. The checked object (MF-62; Spec 126 11a.7 dated note 2026-11-11, Spec 135 FE-35): ROOT-ONLY like slots, never a node, only on a `lifecycle: loading` tree (checked by the lock and the renderer, not by this shape): the loading state "What we checked", every text a content template of report-presentation.json states.checked filled with a server-formatted value, and the pace the server computed (integer milliseconds). Extended only by a dated note, a register row and a lock. Dated 2026-11-11 (MF-62 follow-up, the processing sequence; Spec 126 11a.7 dated note): each line carries its loading `verb` (content) and `done_ms`; `ready` (the line naming the report and the address, at `at_ms`) and `open` (the reduce-motion action) are required.
